description: The schema of one shared lookup table (a dimension: districts, schools, counties, tracts, block_groups, or demographics): its key columns (schools use district_code plus school_code together), the attribute columns a join adds, the keys that link to other data (`link_keys`: districts.district_census_id reaches Census data through a crosswalk; it is a 5-digit Census school-district code, not a county FIPS code), and, for demographics, how the values relate (`semantics`: within a category the values do not overlap, and `all` is the total). Useful before writing a link_query join.
